title: Reduced Matrix Multiplication: Input-Adaptive Matrix-Product Reduction for LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.13426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformer-based language models achieve strong performance but incur substantial inference cost due to repeated high-dimensional matrix multiplications. We propose Reduced Matrix Multiplication (RMM), a training-free, input-adaptive inference method that reduces Transformer matrix products by selecting informative slices along their contraction dimensions, without modifying model weights. Under a simple retention-ratio control, RMM provides a smooth and predictable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Across language models ranging from 1B to 70B parameters, we find that reduction tolerance depends on the model family, task, component, and retention ratio, although it often improves with model scale. Under moderate reduction, RMM remains robust across the evaluated discriminative, autoregressive generation, and long-context settings. translated_title: 缩减矩阵乘法：面向LLM推理的输入自适应矩阵乘积缩减
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的语言模型虽然性能强劲，但由于重复的高维矩阵乘法运算，其推理成本高昂。我们提出了缩减矩阵乘法（RMM），一种无需训练、输入自适应的推理方法，通过沿收缩维度选择信息丰富的切片来缩减Transformer矩阵乘积，且无需修改模型权重。在简单的保留率控制下，RMM提供了平滑且可预测的精度-效率权衡。在从1B到70B参数的语言模型中，我们发现缩减容忍度取决于模型家族、任务、组件和保留率，尽管它通常随模型规模增大而提升。在适度缩减下，RMM在评估的判别式、自回归生成和长上下文设置中均保持稳健。我们进一步表明，该原理同样适用于多模态视觉-语言推理。机理消融实验揭示了其内在机制。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的输入自适应矩阵缩减方法（RMM），通过沿收缩维度选择信息切片，在保持模型权重不变的情况下实现LLM推理的精度-效率平滑权衡，并验证了其在不同规模模型及多模态场景中的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Reduced Matrix Multiplication (RMM), a training-free, input-adaptive method that reduces Transformer matrix products by selecting informative slices along contraction dimensions, enabling a smooth accuracy-efficiency trade-off for LLM inference across scales and modalities.
